referencePolicy: Each call includes the refs specified in asset-list.js plus approved r2 artwork. Object calls use three original reference images and two r2 object images; the scene uses two original reference images and r2 scene plus both portraits. The socket refinement uses the r2 cup and the generated matching plain divider.
processingPolicy: Pillow and NumPy are used only for requested canvas sizing and placement, alpha-edge cleanup, and the explicitly authorized external black outline reinforcement. No blur is applied. Internal colors and linework are not redrawn. Character outlines inside the scene are not reinforced. New PNGs contain no text metadata.
lineMeasurementPolicy: Widths are sampled along one documented raster scan at each object's outer boundary, relative to the alpha bounding box's short side. These samples do not certify every curve's normal width. The generated mint plug sample is 10.1%, within one raster pixel of the upper target, and was not thinned.

- Window/wall x=0-100%, y=0-20%, dark green frames, night street visible. Pendant lights remain in this top band.
- Bar top x=4-98%, y=22-77%, a clean horizontal rectangle of light wood.
- Puzzle area x=20-75%, y=26-74% MUST be empty pale wood with only quiet grain and lighting. No objects, no people, no shadow silhouettes, no grid lines.
- Partition area x=75-84%, y=22-77% MUST also be empty pale wood. DO NOT DRAW ANY PARTITION, sockets or dividers; the game overlays them separately.
- Player's open laptop strictly x=6-19%, y=28-56%, small mint sticker, no text. Keep wholly outside puzzle area. One iced drink x=7-15%, y=58-71%.
- Neighbor's open laptop strictly x=86-97%, y=28-56%, small brick-red sticker, bright blank screen. Keep wholly outside partition area.
- Player's head and shoulders x=4-25%, y=76-100%, rear view, messy black hair and mint hoodie. A visible GREEN bent straw points up-right. Crop body at bottom edge, don't overlap the empty puzzle region.
- Neighbor's head and shoulders x=79-100%, y=76-100%, rear view, black hair, big WHITE headphones and brick-red hoodie, cropped at bottom edge.
No other people in the central play area. No props or illustration frames in the empty puzzle/partition zone.
